name: layered compatibility testing strategy
summary: Portability is designed structurally, tested cheaply and broadly, and proven selectively on real hardware. Six test modes; CI runs the cheap layers on every change with no accelerator; a GPU host is created only for bounded acceptance work that needs one.

test_modes.T1: replay of evidence captured from real machines; no server
test_modes.note: A mode is never an evidence level and never a support claim. T0-T2 produce L1; T3-T4 can produce L2; T5 normally L3; integrated acceptance earns L4.

steps: clean isolated artifact install and smoke

enforced: a claimed fixture exists on disk
real evidence cites a stage package
a gap states a revisit trigger
no shape claims a profile its evidence level does not support

K-20.problem: state_root resolved against the working directory; an environment variable set on the command line silently did nothing; two invocations from different directories built two unrelated state stores
K-20.solution: the composition root resolves KULTRUN_STATE_ROOT, makes the root absolute once at startup, hands the resolved path down, and warns when an installed artifact defaulted

proofs: unconfigured artifact warns and names the path it fell back to
configured root honoured when run from /
same configuration from /tmp resolved to the same root; no stray .state
records reused rather than duplicated across working directories

stage_1_2.scope: policy headroom only; no probing, per the approved roadmap
real_host_needed_for: assigned accelerator capacity from the live driver
the 2.15 PB mount against a real filesystem
stage_1_2.central_regression_case: reported 2.15 PB must never become safe 2.15 PB
